Subject: Upcoming renewal — Redwood Inference (account 58-REDF)

Hi Marcus / Laura,

Hope you both are well. Our records show your annual contract for Amplitude (account 58-REDF) is up for renewal on 2026-03-15. I attached the proposed renewal pricing (Amplitude_Q3-pricing.pdf) and the standard SLA amendment we usually offer.

Summary: 1-year renewal, standard seat/license counts as current, list price: $128,500. We can extend the current overage credits and include 2 free onboarding hours.

Next steps I suggest:
- Confirm headcount/seats you want to carry into the next term
- Flag any security/compliance questions (we can provide SOC2 and data residency docs)
- Let me know if you'd like a 30-min refresh call to walk the changes

If you're evaluating alternatives (I heard Mixpanel is on your radar), happy to discuss where Amplitude's roadmap maps to your needs.

Best,
Samira Patel

Amplitude

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2026 10:02:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Upcoming renewal — Redwood Inference (account 58-REDF)

Laura / Hannah / Monica — FYI, Amplitude sent the renewal packet this morning (attached). Quick context: we ran product analytics on Amplitude for most of last year; Segment handles our event routing. We're starting an eval of Mixpanel + Snowplow for a narrower set of product funnels to reduce cost on high-cardinality APIs.

Questions I have for this group:
- Can operations/CS confirm whether current seat counts in the attached PDF match usage? (Laura)
- Security: what exact docs do we need (SOC2, encryption at rest, data retention options)? (Hannah)
- Commercial: open to pushing on discount / credits; if we move some traffic off to Mixpanel, we want a commensurate price. How aggressive can procurement be? (Monica)

I think we should aim to: 1) get the vendor to hold price for 30 days while we complete evaluation; 2) try to get an introductory discount or feature credits; 3) make sure SLA/data residency clauses reflect our compliance needs.

I'll schedule a 30-min sync next week unless you prefer to handle asynchronously.

— Marcus
Director, Platform Partnerships
Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Feb 2026 14:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Upcoming renewal — Redwood Inference (account 58-REDF)

Thanks Marcus. Quick initial pass — I pulled usage (see internal sheet: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-amp-renewal). Highlights:
- Active seats: 42 (we're currently paying for 50) — we can reduce to 45 with a quick cleanup of unused seats
- Event volume last 12 months: 2.1B events, with ~35% long-tail high-cardinality events that drive up bill
- Feature set we use: cohorts, behavioral cohorts, charts + experiment integration (mission-critical).

Commercial suggestion: ask for a mid-term true-up and a platform credit to offset high-cardinality costs. If we threaten to move up to 25% of traffic to Mixpanel/Snowplow, vendor will likely respond with a discount.

I've added a column in the sheet with a proposed target price of $95k/year (net), which assumes a 25% workload migration and a 15–25% vendor discount.

I'll also reach out to procurement/legal to confirm necessary docs.

Laura
Head of Product Analytics
Redwood Inference
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 22 Feb 2026 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Upcoming renewal — Redwood Inference (account 58-REDF)

+1 on documentation. From a security/compliance perspective we need:
- Latest SOC 2 Type II report (or a certified letter from auditor)
- Encryption details (at rest/in transit) and key management options (KMS/HSM)
- Data retention & deletion API details for EU/US customers
- Subprocessor list and any cross-border transfer safeguards

I'll open the security questionnaire and ping Amplitude's security team if it's available. Also cc procurement — we need a PO timeline if we do move forward.

Hannah
Security & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Upcoming renewal — Redwood Inference (account 58-REDF)

Hi Marcus / Laura — thanks for the quick context and the usage notes. We can do the following to keep things moving while you complete your evaluation:

1) Hold the current quoted pricing for 30 days (until 2026-03-21) while you complete any vendor assessment.
2) Offered commercial: 20% net discount off the attached pricing if you commit to a 12-month renewal.
3) Provide SOC2 Type II report and subprocessor list (attached SLA/proposal contains links).
4) If you need more run credits for a POC with Mixpanel comparison, we can offer a $5k credit towards a side-by-side evaluation.

I attached the SLA proposal and the secure link to our SOC2 report. If that sounds reasonable we can send a DocuSign with the 12-month amendment.

Samira Patel

Amplitude

Subject: Re: Upcoming renewal — Redwood Inference (account 58-REDF)

Samira — thanks for the quick response and for holding pricing while we run our side-by-side. A few items on our side before any DocuSign: 

1) Commercial: 20% is a good starting point, but because we are a long-term partner and may consolidate more workload with Amplitude if roadmaps align, we need a net target closer to 30% off list or equivalent platform credits. Can Amplitude increase the discount to 30% or add additional $10k evaluation credit?

2) SLA/ops: we need a written RTO/RPO commitment for event routing failures and a 99.9% API uptime SLA for ingestion endpoints. The SLA draft you sent is fine as baseline but legal will need a couple of tweaks (term for credits and a data deletion SLO).

3) Security: thanks — please send the SOC2 Type II binder and subprocessor list to security@redwood.com. We will exercise our standard questionnaire if needed.

4) Timing: we ask that Amplitude hold the 30-day pricing window until 2026-03-21 and not process automatic renewals; procurement will need until 2026-03-18 to finalize a PO if we accept terms.

We are open to a 12-month renewal if the above commercial and SLA items are addressed. I've attached a draft SOW with expected deliverables and the internal estimate to reconcile seat counts.

— Marcus
Director, Platform Partnerships
Redwood Inference
